notes.title: More Storming Kobolds' Divine Powers and Buildings -Official Version Released!
notes.content:
‘The kobold army has attacked our village again. Please, God's angel, come down and save us!’
Your people have been invaded by kobolds again, but this time you will come down to save the world with a new level of cultivation, come and see how your abilities have improved!

*Added the fifth level
*Added infinite mode
*Add new Light Power, God Speed and God Blessing.
*Add new divine power - Holy Light Totem
*Add new buildings such as Thorns and Repair Shops.
*Increase the community bonding mechanism, when the proportion of the corresponding community is too low, it will prioritise the generation of creatures of that community.
*Increase the hint box of formation position direction and position display.
*Add hints for trees on blocks.
*Add the function of deleting a skill individually.
*Adjust the background of the temple
*Adjust Aurora Tower values
*Adjust the logic of destroying divine power, when there is construction, it comes with that divine power.
*Adjust the difficulty value
*Adjusted the logic of erosion rune to speed up the disappearance rate.
*Adjusted protagonist movement speed logic
*Adjusted skill text
*Adjusted stone terrain to also allow for building placement.
*Fix the problem with the decimal number of straw beliefs.
*Fixed the problem that the main character displays the wrong profession.

Build your territory
Expand your territory, now kobolds will come in and get lost!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777737/adda84767e7836561c039abb2e155940847a4fbf.gif

Build Towers to Defend Your Enemy
Build all sorts of defence towers so that not a single mosquito can fly in

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777737/4754765af4c5718d71c2df0434306712e4607ba8.gif

Learn Divine Powers
Learn various divine powers and torture kobolds with the power of lightning and the power of fire!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777737/3348e2337086874db24339c3b6f4537a38e1d3dc.gif

Incarnate the Imperial Enemy
You can also get hands-on with your own incarnation as a warrior and archer, hand-to-hand combat against kobolds!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777737/d8259e46a5ffed1f788bc9e43926d2d4a6125bc7.gif

And the newly stocked defence equipment!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777737/b5e8d7d211e957dd28f0e0d29ccaab97f3bd1629.gif

More for you to discover in-game! If you have any feedback or suggestions for Scarecropia, please join DISCORD to discuss the great cause of demon felling!

notes.title: Early Access V1.11.73 & DEMO V1.11.72 Updates | Adjustments & Fixes
notes.content:
【Game Adjustments】

 Add the mechanism for replaying the previous levels. In case of failure, the originally cleared settlements will be automatically retained.
 Add the logic of group damage attenuation for enemies. The damage will decrease as the number of attackers increases.
 Optimize the spawning point logic. There will be no deserts around the spawning points.
 Adjust the numerical values in the normal difficulty of the game.
 Delete the logic that victory cannot lead to the temple in the last level.
 Delete the restart logic in the last level.


【Improvements and Fixes】

 Improve the occurrence times of quota events. The same quota event can only appear once within one level.
 Fix the problem that some users encounter a white screen when entering the game. 

Welcome to join our DISCORD！

notes.title: Early Access Release Now!
notes.content:
The sandbox building game Scarecropia, where you can lead (and enslave) a group of believers to develop a strong village and resist the invasion of the Goblins, has finally EARLY ACCESS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777737/9c1d1c427b0849c53617c749c8cd15e00ed43279.jpg

During the DEMO, thank you very much for playing and for your suggestions, I've consolidated all your feedback and added it to the EA:

1. Opened all levels, ruins, buildings, resources and character skills.
2. Add new powers and talents.    
3. Add the culprit of desertification - the weird little sheep
4. Add the logic of the independent working time of the formation and optimised the formation battle
5. Add weapons to the Goblin Squad and optimised their battle logic.
6. Enhanced dark forces: new fallen creatures will build dark bases centred around the creepy hut and torture you from time to time.
7. Add Cracks: Deep, bottomless caves may spawn dark avatars.
8. Add Dark Runes: These strange ripples may erode your mind.            
9. Add Behavioural Mode: Creatures may steal resources from the base!
10. New Bad Climate: Black Storms will continue to eat away at your creations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777737/f9ba6adb8f40c13497aaa493375f2eb854b540f5.png

The UI also got a update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777737/215fef1afd6640446ec530ef88ad98661b5b1c69.png

To thank you for your support and suggestions, I will draw 5 people in DISCORD group to give away $1 Steam Card, come and join us!

【Time】From now until 8 November.

【Gift】$1 Steam Card

 *We will announce the winning list and reward payment in the DISCORD group within 7 days after the closing date of the event, Just stay tuned~

Now I'm adding more new content to the 1.0 Version, Tell me what you want and join us DISCORD let me know that.
The new version will be updated with your suggestions!
